environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native) deployed in a public subnet with Internet Gateway route. Lambda function URL enabled with AuthType NONE. Function has IAM role with SecretsManager and DynamoDB access. VPC configuration: subnet-0a1b2c3d (public, 10.0.1.0/24) with route table pointing 0.0.0.0/0 to igw-abc123. No request validation layer. Environment variables AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN populated by Lambda runtime.
